notes.title: Blade Master Boss -Core Abilities Completed and Plasma Cannon Added to Inventory
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello Peacemakers,[/b][/p][p]For our FPS game currently in development, the boss character [b]Blade Master[/b] has received major improvements. In addition, the [b]Plasma Cannon[/b] has been updated with new balancing adjustments and visual enhancements.[/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Blade Master’s Auto Attack ability has been completed. Attack frequency, blade throwing speed, and the number of blades can now be adjusted based on difficulty level.[/p][/*][*][p]Blade visibility has been improved and trail effects have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Projectile management now uses an [b]Object Pooling system[/b] instead of Instantiate/Destroy. Performance has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]NavMesh Agent speed has been increased, and 8-directional strafe movement animations have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Trail effects have been added to the blades carried by the boss. In future updates, Blade Master will use the blades he carries from his own blade pool.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug that prevented the [b]Close Range Push[/b] ability from working in builds (while working in the editor) has been fixed. Control methods have been simplified and optimized.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug that prevented health regeneration while Invulnerable has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Animation conflicts during state transitions (attack, heal, push, skill use, search, etc.) have been resolved.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Plasma Cannon Updates:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Camera recoil shake has been increased, and the animation now includes an upward kick as well as backward.[/p][/*][*][p]Plasma projectile speed has been reduced. While active, it now emits light over a wide area. On impact, it scatters sparks with physics-based particles, and these sparks now emit small lights on the surfaces they touch.[/p][/*][*][p]The base damage of the weapon has been nearly doubled, while the fire rate has been reduced from 240 to 180 RPM. With slower projectile speed, the risk-reward balance has been strengthened. Its effectiveness at long range has been reduced, but it has become extremely powerful at close range.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Update showcase video: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/lvgcvC7f99w?si=wSVZ595vV6OGGZ0C"][/dynamiclink][/p]
